content.short: The Sandbox is a blockchain-based 3D metaverse play-to-earn game where players can explore, buy NFT land, build experiences, and earn income.
content.description: The Sandbox is a blockchain-based, play-to-earn 3D metaverse game built on the Ethereum network. Players can explore a rich virtual world, visit diverse locations, and own all in-game NFTs whose ownership is verifiable on the blockchain. They can purchase land as NFTs, design and construct buildings and interactive experiences, and earn income by creating, showcasing, and monetizing their creations within the metaverse, while the assets they own are tracked on the blockchain for verifiability and security.
